integrity: The infinite statement is proved combinatorially. Exhaustive computation for \(3\le n\le8\) checks 4,053,088 matching-subset instances directly against extension counts; the computation is verification, not the proof.
scientific_limitations: The scalar equality \(f(\operatorname{Cr}_n)=n-2\) is not claimed as original because later general bipartite forcing-number results cover that level. The retained claim is the exact classification of all forcing subsets of every perfect matching, the \(n-t_2(\pi)\) minimum-set count, and the aggregate enumerator. An earlier 1985 book chapter is cited as a historical root, but no trustworthy exact public day for it was located, so the exact-day archive anchor is 1987-06-01.
title: All forcing subsets of perfect matchings in crown graphs
